metadata.description: The official AI Success Labs plugin marketplace — student toolkit for the Brand Magnetism Accelerator. Frameworks, content engine, and visual prompts for building a magnetic LinkedIn brand with AI.

plugins.name: brand-magnetism-starter
plugins.description: The student starter kit for the Brand Magnetism Accelerator. Includes the 5-Day Brand Engine, Post Architecture, the two-mode LinkedIn Content Engine, image and infographic prompt generators, LinkedIn competitor and social-media trend research skills (Apify), and a my-linkedin-voice template you customise to your own voice.
